claims.title: CLI size validation
claims.statement: The CLI rejects fractional and non-finite sizes with an error and no ID. A request for seven characters returns one seven-character ID.
assumptions: The formal model represents parsed numeric values with a separate finite flag.

review.overview: Nano ID's CLI validates the requested ID size.
scope_limits: This contract covers only the CLI size option.
verification_limits: The formal check covers the numeric rule. The custom behavior check exercises four concrete inputs, and the native check runs the approved upstream CLI tests on a trusted host with Node.js 26.10.0 as the reference.

required_cases: shows an error on unknown argument
shows an error if size is not a number
requires error if size is a negative number
